- Expected first-phase spend: POC (~$8–15k) then scale if results look good.

Procurement/commercial items we discussed — can you confirm: 
1) Preferred payment mechanism: PO (standard for annual deals) vs corporate card for POC/one-off invoices vs marketplace purchase?
2) Procurement packet: Are there any required fields on your PO or a PO template we should populate?
3) Budget owner / finance sponsor and final signatory for SOW/MSA.
4) Target timeline for approvals (we heard ~2–4 weeks internally from Evan).

Attachments: I attached a short procurement checklist and a draft SOW to speed things up.

Suggested next steps
- Evan: confirm procurement path (PO vs card vs marketplace) and who the budget owner is.
- Priya: if helpful, a short email with the named finance sponsor and any PO template / PO routing instructions.
- Marissa & Vivek: we’ll prepare the procurement packet and a marketplace option summary.

We’re happy to do a short sync with your procurement/finance team to walk the packet through — 20–30 min should do it.

Thanks,

1) Payment mechanism: For pilots/POC under $20k we typically use a corporate card or internal petty purchase. Anything expected to be >$25–50k goes through a standard PO (Finance creates a PO and we route it to Legal for any contract signature).

2) Budget owner: the funding for this POC is owned by the Customer Experience org; the finance sponsor is Priya Shah (cc’d). Final signatory for agreements over our threshold is usually Michael Donovan (Legal), but Priya will confirm.

3) PO template: I’ll attach our standard PO template — procurement@acme.com will fill any missing fields. We can also explore buying via the Acme Marketplace if Redwood lists the SKU there; that often speeds procurement.

We’ll aim to get internal alignment this week and get back with the budget owner confirmation and a timeline.
